text:
monitor-bot: ALERT: hosted-usw2 GPU pool saturation spike detected. p95 queueing > 1.2s and admission drop rate increased to 18% in last 5m. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/hosts/usw2-pool

kai: seeing same on the heatmap, headroom collapsed for pool-12 and pool-13, lots of tiny fragments.

maria: is this noisy alert or real? any deployments in the last 10m?

ajay: no big deploys. noticed a sudden embedders traffic bump from onboarding jobs hitting low-quantized model. probably batch sizes spiking.

jenny: confirmed a tenancy from partner-team hitting 40k concurrent embedding requests ~5m ago. looks like their client retried on 429s making it worse. :grimacing:

oncall-platform: I'll open incident channel if it holds >10m. For now can we apply soft throttle to that tenant? policy id: tenant-rate-emb-v2

kai: +1 to soft throttle. Also recommend enabling spillover routing to hosted-eus3 for non-sensitive requests. config snippet: ```yaml
routing:
  policy: cost-latency
  fallbacks: [eus3]
  max_spill: 0.15
```

maria: can we reduce default embed batch_size from 256 -> 128 for that tenant to lower P95?

ajay: yea we can push a prod flag to reduce batch for that tenancy. will do a staged flag: `feature.reduce_embed_batch=true` targeting tenant id 0x7f2

monitor-bot: NOTE: evictions increased by 3x in pool-12 during spike, preemptible nodes reclaimed by cloud autoscaler.

jenny: autoscaler logs show odd delay: `provisioner: pod_creates_pending for 80s` — hitting cloud API quotas in region. cc @cloud-ops

oncall-platform: ok, plan: 1) apply soft throttle to tenant (ajay) 2) enable spillover to eus3 for non-sensitive embed traffic (kai) 3) flag reduce batch (ajay) 4) request cloud-ops to bump API quota / short-term emergency scale (maria) 5) monitor p95 for 30m then reassess.

kai: I'll enable spillover now and push routing change. pushing to canary then global.

ajay: applying throttle + batch flag now. rolling to target tenant.

maria: pinged cloud-ops ticket #CO-3421 to request temporary quota bump and priority create calls. link: https://tickets.redwood.ai/CO-3421

monitor-bot: ALERT UPDATE: admission drop rate down to 6% after throttle + spillover, p95 reduced to ~420ms. continuing to watch.

jenny: nice. still seeing some image-warmup bursts causing small spikes, but stable for now.

oncall-platform: leaving this open for 45m. anyone seeing relapse call it out here. also add postmortem note if tenant retries caused amplification.

kai: adding dashboard annotation and creating a short ops runbook entry for tenant-induced spikes.

ajay: followup actions: ticket to partner-team to instrument client-side jittered backoff, and add admission backpressure metric to tenant-level dashboard.

maria: cool. if things go green by +45m we'll close. thanks team :thumbsup:
